changelog:
Settings, tidied up. Every option now lives in one place.

WHAT CHANGED

- Settings opens as a short list: Appearance, Playback, Television, Content, EPG, Backup & Restore, Diagnostics and App. Tap one to see its options on its own page, and use Back to return to the list.
- The five reconnect options sit under their own Reconnecting heading on the Playback page.
- More, then Sources, now lists your sources. Add a new one from the top of the list, tap one to edit it, or turn it off from there. Before, More only opened the form for adding a source, and editing was hidden at the bottom of Settings.
- Content languages and Send log and backup appear once, in More. They were also in Settings.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Every setting keeps its value; nothing was removed, only moved.

NOT YET

- A fuller visual refresh of the other screens.
